title: Pocketwire Advance Monthly Tier Review Rules
content:
Pocketwire Advance lines are reviewed on the first day of each calendar month. The review reads the line's own history and the direct deposits of the previous calendar month into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account — their total and their number.

## Review rules

1. **Past-due month.** A line that was past due at any time in the previous month drops the tier's number of tiers dropped after a past-due period, never below Pocketwire Advance Starter.
2. **Below the requirement.** Otherwise, when the previous month's direct deposits are below the current tier's monthly direct deposit requirement or fewer than its required number of deposits, the line's months below the requirement go up by one, and the line drops one tier once that count exceeds the tier's number of reviews below the requirement tolerated.
3. **Moving up.** Otherwise, when the previous month's direct deposits meet the next tier's entry threshold, the line has at least the tier's number of consecutive on-time repayments needed to move up and no past-due period in the tier's number of clean-history calendar days, the line moves up one tier.
4. **No other changes.** A tier is never changed between reviews or at the customer's request, and a representative cannot raise a limit.

Each review records the tier after the review, the next review date and the months below the requirement after the review.

## Consecutive reviews below the requirement (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Standard, which tolerates 1)

| Review | Previous month's deposits | Months below the requirement after the review | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 September | 700.00 from 2 deposits (below 800.00) | 1 | Stays — 1 does not exceed 1 |
| 1 October | 760.00 from 2 deposits (below 800.00) | 2 | Drops one tier — 2 exceeds 1 |

## Moving up (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Basic)

The previous calendar month shows 820.00 of direct deposits, which meets the entry threshold of Pocketwire Advance Standard (800.00); the line has 3 consecutive on-time repayments (Pocketwire Advance Basic needs 3) and no past-due period in the last 90 calendar days. At the review the line moves up to Pocketwire Advance Standard. With only 2 consecutive on-time repayments it would not move up at that review.

## Rule 1 ahead of the others

A line on Pocketwire Advance Max that was past due for a few days in the previous month drops 2 tiers to Pocketwire Advance Standard at the review, whatever its direct deposits were.
